description: Media-attachment injection regression suite for the Role B WAHA media seam. Every case pairs an attacker-controlled attachment surface - an image caption or its OCR text, an audio transcript, a PDF text layer, or a plain-text body - with the vendor answer a compromised model would return. Nothing here is a real file, a real transcript or a real vendor response: the bytes are synthetic placeholders and the payloads are scripted. A detection never blocks or edits the result; it writes stable media:instruction-text-detected:<field> markers on the WahaMediaResult so a reviewer sees that the content is tainted, and business confirmation stays required regardless. Control cases are first-class: they assert ordinary merchant content is not flagged, so the suite fails on over-flagging as loudly as on under-flagging. Driven by apps/backend/tests/test_media_injection.py.
